title: Conditions of Suspension and Reinstatement of Cover Under the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans
content:
Cover under an Extended Equipment Warranty Plans plan is suspended once a premium invoice stays unpaid beyond the tier's suspension period counted from the day the invoice fell due, counting calendar days with the due day excluded and the final day included, and also where a tier that requires maintenance finds the building's maintenance agreement no longer in force. A failure that happens while cover is suspended is never covered, even where the arrears are settled afterwards, because cover did not stand on the day of the failure. Cover is put back in force once the arrears are settled or the maintenance agreement is reinstated, the tier's reinstatement fee is charged, and the term is not extended by the suspended days. Reinstatement without a fresh condition inspection is possible only inside the tier's reinstatement window counted forward in calendar days from the day cover was suspended, the suspension day excluded and the final day included.

## Condition A — suspension for premium arrears

A.1 The clock starts on the day the premium invoice fell due, as the invoice record carries it.

A.2 The suspension period is the tier's figure in calendar days. The due day is not counted; each following calendar day is counted; the final day of the period is the first day on which the invoice has stayed unpaid beyond the period, and cover may be suspended on that day or any later day while the invoice stays unpaid.

A.3 The invoice consulted is the premium invoice, identified by its invoice reference and its recorded due date.

### Boundary on hypothetical dates

| Tier | Suspension period | Invoice fell due | Final day of the period | Still unpaid on | Cover suspended |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Compressor Coverage Plan | 30 calendar days | 31 March | 30 April | 29 April | Not yet — the period has not run |
| Compressor Coverage Plan | 30 calendar days | 31 March | 30 April | 30 April | Yes |
| Parts Protection Plan | 45 calendar days | 31 March | 15 May | 15 May | Yes |

## Condition B — suspension for a lapsed maintenance agreement

Where the tier requires maintenance and the building's maintenance agreement is found no longer in force, cover is suspended.

## Condition C — a failure during suspension

A failure on a day on which cover was suspended is never covered. Settling the arrears afterwards does not reach back: cover did not stand on the day of the failure.

## Condition D — reinstatement

D.1 Cover is put back in force once the arrears are settled or the maintenance agreement is reinstated.

D.2 The tier's reinstatement fee is charged on reinstatement.

D.3 The term is not extended by the suspended days: the cover end day is the day it was before the suspension.

D.4 Reinstatement without a fresh condition inspection is possible only inside the tier's reinstatement window: the day cover was suspended, as the plan record carries it, is not counted; each following calendar day is counted; the final day of the window is inside it. Reinstatement after the final day needs a fresh condition inspection.

### Boundary on hypothetical dates

| Tier | Window | Cover suspended on | Final day of the window | Reinstated on | Fresh condition inspection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Compressor Coverage Plan | 45 calendar days | 30 April | 14 June | 14 June | Not needed |
| Compressor Coverage Plan | 45 calendar days | 30 April | 14 June | 15 June | Needed |
| Total Equipment Protection Plan | 90 calendar days | 30 April | 29 July | 29 July | Not needed |

## The tier figures the conditions read

The suspension period in calendar days, the reinstatement fee in USD and the reinstatement window in calendar days are the tier's own figures under the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans.
